No. 2062/42– FRIDAY, MARCH 16, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: 2/2/1/144-52/2017. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2016/HW/443. I hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 1 - 18 ( Lots 18) allotments in total extent of about 0.2819 Hectare, of land in Preliminary Plan No. Gam 4075 and dated 24.01.2018 prepared by the Senior - Superintendent of Surveys of Gampaha District on behalf of Surveyor General , situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 215B, Galahitiyawa East in the Minor Division of Mada Paththuwa in the Village of Galahitiyawa in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Gampaha in Gampaha District in the Western Province.

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Munamalgahawatta; Description: Contains a Garden, a Attoniya tree about 20 years old; Claimant: J.L.A.Ariya Bhadra Ekanayaka, No. 165/A, Galahitiayawa, Ganemulla; Original Claimant; (For acquisition); Extent: 0.0022 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Munamalgahawatta; Description: Contains a Garden, 2 Coconut trees about 30 years old; Claimant: K.S. Silva, No. 165/D, Galahitiyawa, Ganemulla; Original Claimant; (For acquisition); Extent: 0.0112 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Munamalgahawatta; Description: Contains a Garden, 4 Coconut trees about 10 years old and 4 Coconut trees about 50 years old; Claimant: S.M.D. Samarakoon,No. 235C, Galahitiayawa, Ganemulla; Original Claimant; (For acquisition); Extent: 0.0243 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Munamalgahawatta; Description: Contains a Garden, a Part of the Permanent Building, Cement well, 2 jack trees about 10 years old, 2 mahogany trees about 5 years old and 2 rambutan trees about 8 years old; Claimant: W.A.R.D. Weerabandu, No. 237B. Galahitiyawa, Ganemulla and Samitha Uwathmi Wickramarathna,C/D - 9/17, Rampokunugama, Nittambuwa; Original Claimant; (For acquisition); Extent: 0.0220 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Munamalgahawatta; Description: Road; Claimant: Samitha Uwathmi Wickramarathna, C/D - 9/17, Ranpokunugama, Nittambuwa, H.A. Lahiru Udana and Others, 237/1, Galhitiyawa, Ganemulla; Original Claimant; (For acquisition); Extent: 0.0043 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Gampaha on the from 28/03/2018 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25/03/2018, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, and the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Divisional Secretary & Acquiring Officer, Gampaha. Gampaha Divisional Secretary’s Office, 15th March, 2018. 03 – 1362
